## load packages and data

```{r message=F}
rm(list = ls())

library(lavaan) # v.0.6-21
library(here) # v.1.0.1
library(dplyr) # v.1.2.1 

load(here("Analysis_data", "df_somatomotor_rawfunc.Rda"))
df <- df_somatomotor_rawfunc

df <- df %>% 
  rename(
    SI = "–SI",
    )
```


## Coupling and Intelligence

```{r}
SCFC_int_model <- '
## coupling model
coupling =~ NA*SI + PT + RE + C + DE
coupling ~~ 1*coupling
RE ~~ DE
PT ~~ DE
C ~~ 0*C

## intelligence model
int =~ NA*BIS + equal("int=~BIS")*APM
int ~~ 1*int

BIS =~ NA*PC_Mean + PS_Mean + C_Mean + M_Mean
BIS ~~ 1*BIS

APM =~ NA*PropCorrOdd + equal("APM=~PropCorrOdd")*PropCorrEven
APM ~~ 1*APM


## structural model
int ~ coupling
'

fit_SCFC_int <- cfa(SCFC_int_model, data = df, std.lv = T, 
                      missing = "ML")

summary(fit_SCFC_int, fit.measures = T, standardized = TRUE)

zFit <- standardizedsolution(fit_SCFC_int)
regressions <- subset(zFit, op == "~")

inspect(fit_SCFC_int, "r2")
```
